code='''def transform(grid):
    """Project matching nonzero markers on either side of a solid separator."""
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row.count(6) == 1]
    # This task uses a vertical separator column; identify it by a color that
    # occurs exactly once in every row.
    if not sep_rows:
        raise ValueError("separator not found")

    right_width = len(grid[0]) - sep - 1

        raise ValueError("unaligned sides")
